content.what_it_is: MATLAB visualization script for the FUNWAVE-TVD tide_frf_abc_data case (FRF tide long run, Case_15deg_longrun): builds an MP4 movie of surface elevation with synthetic breaker-bubble and foam layers over a Google Earth image of the FRF site. It reads binary single-precision output (fopen/fread with dims [m n]=[660 800], then transpose+flipud+fliplr to orient) for dep (L12-L18) and per frame for eta, mask, age (L54-L77). Coordinates x=[1:m]*1.+105, y=[n:-1:1]*1.0+220 approximately register the model grid onto the image frf_03.jpg (L22, L25-L27). Visualization fields are fabricated from the wave-age output: breaker = age clipped to the last 10 s (L84-L85); bubble = 1.5*exp(-breaker/10) with zeros pushed to 9000 and values <0.1 set NaN (L87-L90); foam = 1.0*exp(-age/50) after zeroing age>600 and masking dry cells (L93-L97); eta is NaN-ed on dry cells and under active breakers (L100-L101). Each of 158 frames draws two panels — image + pcolor(eta)+pcolor(bubble) with caxis [-1 3.5], and image + pcolor(foam) with caxis [0 2] — both with a white dotted reference line [110 500]x[620 620], axis [30 600 250 950], and a title showing time = numb*600.0/3600.0 hr (L105-L128), then rasterizes at 300 dpi, resizes to 576x1024, and writes to videoOut.mp4 at 10 fps (L130-L138); closes the video at L142.

unresolved: The 600.0 s per output frame assumed in the time label (L116) is not derivable from this file; it must match PLOT_INTV in the case input, which is not readable here.

bubble and foam are explicitly 'made up' for visualization (comment L81): thresholds 10 s, 600 s, decay scales 10 and 50, amplitudes 1.5 and 1.0, floor 0.1, and sentinel 9000.0 (L84-L97) have no stated physical basis in the file.
Registration offsets +105 and +220 and image rotation imrotate(RGB,1) (L25-L26, L106) are 'approximately' matched per comment L24; the geo-accuracy is unquantified.
The 'age' output field is read as wave/breaker age in seconds (L73, L85, L93); its exact model definition is not in this file.
mov(k).cdata accumulates all 158 frames in memory though each is written immediately (L136-L138); the array is never reused.
foam has no NaN floor analogous to bubble(bubble<0.1)=NaN, so the foam pcolor layer covers the whole wet domain with near-zero values over the background image (L95-L97, L124).
